populations.name: kenyon
populations.reason: Kenyon cells form the intrinsic mushroom-body population. Artificial music features are injected here; no sensory or auditory equivalence is asserted.

populations.name: feedback
populations.reason: Annotated mushroom-body feedback neurons add measured local connectivity. Modulation and receptor physiology are not simulated.

populations.name: mbon
populations.reason: Mushroom-body output neurons provide anatomically motivated readout locations. DJ channel assignments are an engineered mapping.

edgePolicy.reason: The phase-1 model retains measured KC-to-MBON projection and APL/DPM/MBON feedback connections. KC-to-KC edges are omitted to bound the unsigned recurrent drive and computational cost. This is an engineering simplification, not a claim that those biological connections are unimportant. Retained full-circuit weight is reported separately.
